text: City staff have advised our office that, following a request from Election Services to review the parking regulations on Northline Road to accommodate operational needs for the upcoming municipal election, they identified a discrepancy between the existing parking by-law and the posted parking restrictions. To address the discrepancy and support Election Services' operational needs, staff are recommending amendments to the parking regulations and signage. Once implemented, the standard three-hour maximum parking regulation will apply to this section of Northline Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Northline Road, between Cranfield Road and O’Connor Drive.
